Why I Believe AI Models Need Some Controls

—

This episode is sponsored by Maze, and they're introducing a product called Maze Code. Maze agents understand your code instead of matching patterns like legacy SCA and SAST scanners. AI agents investigate every vulnerability with the context from your code, build, and cloud, remove false positives, and catch the business logic flaws other tools miss.

Maze agents trace exploitable vulnerabilities to their root cause and find a fix. Then they ship the verified fix directly to the responsible developer or coding agent. You can learn more at:

https://ul.live/mazecode
